title: 14820-R — AvenEx Opal Breathable Building Wrap Air Barrier
jurisdiction: Canada (CCMC national product assessment; project AHJ not stated)

facts.text: CCMC 14820-R is marked Active in the live API snapshot; the report names NBC 2020 as its edition scope.
Report gives a vapour-barrier condition for use as the main airtight element and addresses other low-permeance layers.
The CCMC report publishes its own code-specific opinion classifications for the printed edition(s); those classifications are bounded by the report conditions.

limitations: The evaluation is a CCMC product assessment, not an individual Alberta variance or project approval.
The report editions are NBC editions identified by the source; no equivalence to NBC(AE) 2023, 2nd printing has been established here.
No project, assembly, jurisdiction/AHJ, loads, site conditions, installation records or professional design package is supplied.
The CCMC opinion is bound by its stated conditions and limitations; read the full report before judging relevance.
